comments.body: This is a reward from the quest Giant fish as large as a ship

How to obtain:
Painter (NPC -- this crest is only available from Stockholm, Nantes, Palma, Pisa, Istanbul, Jaffa, Goa, Santo Domingo, Santiago, Trujillo, Caracas, Cayenne, Pernambuco, Willemstad, Grand Cayman, Lima) - 5,000 ducats
Note: Painter's shop is always located by Craftsman.

Quest: Giant fish as large as a ship
